desc.en: It is narrated from the Holy Prophet (s) that whoever recites this Surah once will get the reward equal to 10 times the number of people who have believed in the Islamic teachings.This Surah has many other rewards and its recitation is compared to reciting a 1/3 of the Holy Qur’an.Reciting it once is a means of blessings for the reciter, if recited twice then the blessings are also showered upon the children of the reciter. Reciting it thrice brings blessings on the entire family of the reciter. If Surah Ikhlas is recited 11 times, the reciter will have palaces built for him in Jannah. When a person recites this Surah 100 times, all his sins for the past 25 years are forgiven (except the sins of killing an innocent person or usurping the property of people). The one who recites it 1000 times will not die unless he sees his place in Jannah.The Holy Prophet (s) once advised a poor person to always say ‘salaam’ when entering his house, even if there was nobody there, and then recite Surah Ikhlaas. After a little while, the man became abundantly wealthy.It is narrated that if a person does not recite this Surah in any of his 5 daily prayers, it is as if he has not prayed. In fact, if a person does not recite this Surah in any of his prayers for 7 consecutive days, and he dies, it will be as if he died while following the religion of Abu Lahab.It is makrooh to recite this Surah in one breath. This Surah has numerous other bene?ts and is a cure for many ailments. It should be recited when travelling or when facing a tyrant ruler.
desc.rurdu: Rasool-e-Khuda (s) se riwaayat hai keh, jo koi Surah Ikhlaas ko ek martaba padhe to usey 10 guna ziyadah sawaab milega un logo’n ki tadaat se jo Islam ke ehkaam ko maante hai.Is Surah ke aur bhi bahot se faaide hai aur iski tilaawat karna 1/3 Qur’an padhne ka sawaab rakhta hai.Is Surah ko 1 martaba padhe, to padhne waale par rehmat hai, 2 martaba padhe, to padhne waale ke bachcho’n par bhi rehmat hai. 3 Martaba padhe, to padhne waale ke tamaam ghar waalo’n par bhi rehmat hai.Agar Surah Ikhlaas ko 11 martaba padhe, to padhne waale ke liye Jannat mein mahelo’n (palaces) ko banaya jaayega. Jab koi shakhs isko 100 martaba padhe, to uske peechle 25 saal ke tamaam gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge (us gunah ke alaawa keh jis mein usne kisi be-gunah ko qatl kiya ho ya logo’n ka haq maar liya ho). Jo koi isko 1000 martaba padhe to woh nahi marega magar yeh keh woh apna maqaam Jannat mein dekh le.Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ne ek baar kisi garib insaan ko taaqid ki keh, ghar mein daakhil hote waqt hamesha salaam karna, agar koi ghar mein na ho tab bhi aur phir Surah Ikhlaas ki tilaawat karna. kuchh arse ke baad (after some time), woh shakhs bahot maal-daar ho gaya.Riwaayat mein hai keh, agar koi shakhs Surah Ikhlaas ki tilaawat koi bhi 5 waajib namazo’n mein na kare, to woh aisa hai keh goya usne namaz hi nahi adaa ki. Aur agar koi shakhs is Surah ko apni koi bhi waajib namaz mein laga-taar 7 dino tak na padhe, aur uski maut ho jaaye, to woh aise hi hai keh, jaise us ne Abu Lahab ke deen ki pairwi karte huwe mara.Is Surah ko ek saans mein padhna makrooh hai. Is Surah ke kahi faaide hai aur bimaariyo’n ka ilaaj bhi is mein hai. Iski tilaawat safar ke waqt ya zaalim haakim ke saamne jaaye tab kare.
desc.urdu: رسول اکرمؐ نے فرمایا:جس نے سورۂ اخلاص کی تلاوت کی اسے اللہ،ملائکہ،کتب،رسل،روزِ قیامت پر ایمان لانے والوں کا دس گنا ثواب ملے گا (مجمع البیان،ج۱۰ص۴۷۹)۔ سورۂ توحید کا پڑھنا ایک تہائی قرآن کے مساوی ہے۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

trans.rurdu: Ay Rasool! Kahe dijiye keh woh Allah ek hai.
trans.urdu: اے رسول کہہ دیجئے کہ وہ اللہ ایک ہے۔

trans.en: Allah is He on Whom all depend.
trans.urdu: اللہ برحق اور بے نیاز ہے۔

trans.en: He begets not, nor is He begotten.
trans.rurdu: Uski na koi aulaad hai aur na waalid.
trans.urdu: اس کی نہ کوئی اولاد ہے اور نہ والد۔

trans.rurdu: Aur na Uska koi kufu (joda) aur hamsar (saathi) hai.
trans.urdu: اور نہ اس کا کوئی کفو اور ہم سر ہے۔

trans.en: Almighty God the most high speaks the truth.
trans.rurdu: Allah buzurg o bartar ne sachh farmaya hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ بزرگ و برتر نے سچ فرمایا ہے۔
